tools.name: docs_list
tools.description: List every published EvalGate documentation page. Use it to browse the catalog when you do not have a search term or slug. Returns each page's slug, title, URL and summary; pass limit/cursor to page through results, or omit both for the whole catalog.

tools.name: docs_search
tools.description: Search published EvalGate documentation by keyword. Use it first when you have a question or topic but no page slug. Returns up to 10 ranked matches with slug, title, URL and summary; read a match in full with docs_get.

tools.name: docs_get
tools.description: Read one published EvalGate documentation page by its slug. Use it after docs_search or docs_list has given you the slug. Returns the page's title, URL, summary and full content, or a not_found error for an unknown slug.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "docs_list" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
